concerns.text: FR-005 and SC-004 require a two-proportion z-test comparing symbolic vs. neural-verifier baselines. Tasks T041, T042, and T043 (neural_baseline execution and comparison) are marked as unchecked `[ ]`. Without these tasks, the statistical significance test mandated by the spec cannot be performed.

SC-005 requires characterizing computational complexity class (Big-O) via log-log regression. Task T029d (Execute Scalability Analysis) is marked `[ ]` and depends on T029e. However, T029c (Run Full Scaling Experiments to generate `scaling_raw_logs.json`) is also marked `[ ]`. The data generation task for the scalability analysis is missing execution, leaving SC-005 unmeasurable.

Constitution Principle VII and FR-004 require reporting energy consumption (Joules). Tasks T008a (TDP Calibration) and T008c (TDP Constant Generation) are marked `[ ]`. The plan relies on these to calculate energy. Without executing these tasks, the energy metrics required by the spec and constitution cannot be derived.

SC-001 requires pre-registration of the statistical framework. Task T028a implements the logic, but there is no explicit task to *execute* the pre-registration and write the artifact (e.g., `data/processed/pre_registration.yaml`) before the experiment runs. The current tasks only implement the code, not the execution of the registration step.

Task T036 appears twice in the document (once in Phase 3, once in Phase 5). The second instance in Phase 5 is a duplicate of the Phase 3 task. This is a writing error that causes confusion in the task list.
